text:
Rhea: FYI audit found object in partner-ci-bucket that starts with `vault:v3:` (newer wrapper) and includes `gcp-kms:` metadata. Key: ci/artifacts/workspace_wrap_v3.bin
sec-bot: Alert: external-object-access detected on partner-ci-bucket (rule:s3-external-access). Incident 3642008888 opened.
Kurt: paste path + first ~60 chars (sanitized) so we can fingerprint.
Rhea: s3://partner-ci-bucket/ci/artifacts/workspace_wrap_v3.bin -> header (sanitized): `vault:v3:7c9d... || gcp-kms:projects/partner-prod/locations/global/keyRings/app/cryptoKeys/ek-01`
Irena: nested envelope w/ GCP KMS inside transit wrapper. If partner CI could call our Vault transit/unwrap proxy and someone had KMS decrypt ability, that's risky.
Samira: do we still have a binding for partner onboarding? I recall a short-lived role for uploads.
Rhea: yes, partner-ci-sa@partner-prod had a BINDING on infra-onboard with role `roles/storage.objectViewer` and a custom `roles/vault-proxy-invoke` (expires 2026-12).
Kurt: containment steps: 1) remove binding 2) revoke partner SA creds 3) quarantine object to sec bucket 4) enable Vault + KMS audit slices. Doing 1-2 now.
Oncall: ran:
  gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding infra-onboard --member="serviceAccount:partner-ci-sa@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/storage.objectViewer"
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-ci-sa@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=partner-ci-sa@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true
Oncall: quarantining:
  aws s3 cp s3://partner-ci-bucket/ci/artifacts/workspace_wrap_v3.bin s3://sec-quarantine/3642008888/workspace_wrap_v3.bin --profile=infra-admin && aws s3 rm s3://partner-ci-bucket/ci/artifacts/workspace_wrap_v3.bin --profile=infra-admin
Irena: enable audit devices:
  vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_transit_v3_audit.log
  # GCP: export Cloud Audit Logs for KMS -> logging bucket, retain 180d
Kurt: rotation plan (short): forced rotate Vault transit key -> rewrap quarantined blobs -> review KMS Cloud Audit for decrypt/crypto operations -> rotate GCP key if any suspicious decrypts. Commands:
  vault write -f transit/keys/app-transit-v3/rotate
  vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext="<old-cipher>" key="app-transit-v3"
Samira: scanning partner buckets for `vault:v3:` and `gcp-kms:` markers now. Uploading scrubbed list to /sec/artifacts/3642008888-list.txt when done.
Kurt: check Vault audit for transit/unwrap and GCP audit for cryptoKeyVersions.decrypt calls referencing that key. Example GCP query pointed to that key ring.
Rhea: partner SOC notified with scrubbed object keys and steps taken. Legal copied.
Legal: prepping partner notification template; will request proof of deletion/quarantine and timeline.
Oncall: no successful transit/unwrap events from partner-SA in initial audit slice; only 403s. Proceed with rotation anyway and tighten RBAC: avoid wildcard transit grants.
Irena: sample Vault policy change:
  path "transit/encrypt/*" { capabilities = ["update"] }
  path "transit/decrypt/*" { capabilities = ["deny"] }
  path "transit/rewrap" { capabilities = ["update"] # internal-only }
Samira: found 4 matching objects across partner buckets; uploaded scrubbed keys + checksums to /sec/artifacts/3642008888-list.txt.
Kurt: will run canary rotate in staging (ETA 30m) then prod. Scheduling post-rotation review 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC.
Rhea: nice catch. Keep updates short here; paste audit snippets (sanitized) into the ticket. :lock:
